title: Paper record
description: One file per paper: data/papers/<id>.yaml. Field names are defined once here and checked against data/vocab.yaml by scripts/check.py.

name.description: Method name as written in Table 1.

authors.description: Author citation string as written in Table 1 (e.g. 'Rajput et al.').

venue.description: Venue string as written in Table 1 (e.g. 'NeurIPS’23', 'KDD’26 ADS', 'arXiv’26').

arxiv.description: Paper URL (arXiv abs URL or DOI URL).

code.description: Official code or project repository URL, or null.

problem.description: Problem band in Table 1 ('psb' for top block, or 'I'–'VI'), checked against data/vocab.yaml.

stage.description: Primary modified stage ('n/a' for psb, or 'Representation', 'Tokenization', 'Backbone', 'Training', 'Inference'), checked against data/vocab.yaml.

representation.description: Representation cell in Table 1 (verbatim, including † and A / B), checked against data/vocab.yaml.

tokenization.description: Tokenization cell in Table 1 (verbatim, including † and A / B), checked against data/vocab.yaml.

backbone.description: Backbone cell in Table 1 (verbatim, including † and A / B), checked against data/vocab.yaml.

tokenizer.description: Tokenizer training cell in Table 1 (verbatim, including † and A / B), checked against data/vocab.yaml.

objective.description: Objective cell in Table 1 (verbatim, including † and A / B), checked against data/vocab.yaml.

inference.description: Inference cell in Table 1 (verbatim, including † and A / B), checked against data/vocab.yaml.

poi.description: Whether the paper targets POI / local-life / spatial recommendation.

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the paper's core mechanism.

evidence.description: Optional list of verbatim quotes and locations from the paper for display.
